reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified dE as a door-not-closed error, had the homeowner remove the king-size duvet and retest with towels, and reached the true cause (overfilled drum pressing on the door/seal) with sensible advice to use a launderette and no part needed. Conversation 2 asked reasonable door questions but, when the customer volunteered the decisive clue (duvet bulging against the glass, corner squashed in the seal), it ignored it, declared the cause unconfirmed and referred to an engineer - an unnecessary escalation for a non-fault that would cost the homeowner time and money. Neither had safety issues, but only Conversation 1 delivered an honest, correct diagnosis.
